startup_first_frame_ms.note: scripts/perf/startup.sh release 10. All ten runs, including the first launch after the local rebuild, are included. Sequential process launches without flushing OS/Metal caches. Budget: < 500 ms p50. Old-machine numbers are separate and are not a regression comparison.

idle_release.status: OVER memory and CPU budgets. Nonzero process idle wakeups; attribution to Tervy timers vs framework/OS remains unverified (A11, M1).
idle_release.method: One visible release window, no terminals or managed children; no build running. After 10 s settle: footprint <pid>, then top -l 31 -s 1 -pid <pid> -stats cpu,idlew. CPU excludes the first sample. IDLEW in default non-event mode is cumulative: rate = (last - first) / timestamp elapsed, not the average column value. top -d was separately probed to verify delta counting. The timer-wakeup budget cannot be assessed by this process counter alone.
